RESOLUTION OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF ZAMEEN PLATINUM (PRIVATE) LIMITED ON THIS 1 ST DAY OF APRIL 2019 
 
 The undersigned, being the Directors of Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited ( “ Company ”) , hereby consent to and adopt in writing the following resolutions as of this 1 st day of April 201 9 : 
 
 Resolved that the Company may proceed to avail a revolving line of credit up to a maximum amount of Rs. 76 0 ,000,000 ( Rupees seven hundred and sixty million ) (“ Loan ”) from Zameen Venture One ( Private) Limited (“ Lender ”) , subject to mutually agreed terms and conditions of a loan a greement to be executed by and between the Company and the Lender in compliance with applicable law(s) (“ Loan Agreement ”) . 
 
 Resolved further that Zeeshan Ali Khan , acting as duly authorized representative of the Company , is hereby authorized to enter into, sign, execute, deliver, and complete the Loan A greement , including such other instruments and documents as may be necessary and proper for closing of the transaction contemplated by the Loan A greement , in compliance with applicable law(s) . 
 
 Resolved further that Zeeshan Ali Khan is hereby authorized to do all such acts as may be necessary on behalf of the Company , from time to time, in order to close the transaction contemplated by the Loan A greement , in compliance with applicable law(s) . 
 
 We, the Directors of Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited , agree to passing of the above resolutions and subscribe our signatures in token of our consent on this 1 st da y of April 2019 . 
 
 
 
 Signed by Imran Ali Khan 
 for and on behalf of Zameen Platinum (Private) Limited
